item.title: State-Sponsored Hackers Using Popular AI Tools Including Gemini, Google Warns
item.description: A new report from Google AI Threat Tracker shows how hackers from North Korea, Iran and Russia are using AI to speed up their attacks.

item.title: Coinbase Stock Surges After Q4 Miss as Analysts Call It 'Too Cheap to Sell'
item.description: Coinbase just fell short of Wall Street expectations, but investors are overlooking the exchange’s resiliency, according to Bernstein.

item.title: $3.85 Million in Ethereum From Mixin Network Hack Sent to Tornado Cash
item.description: Wallets linked to the $200 million exploit of Mixin in 2023 woke after nearly two years and moved funds to coin mixer Tornado Cash.

item.title: Binance France CEO Targeted in Home Invasion Attempt: Report
item.description: The CEO of Binance France was targeted in a recent home invasion attempt, but the executive was unharmed and the criminals were arrested.

item.title: Bitcoin Bounces to $69K, But Charts Are Still Bearish: Analysis
item.description: Bitcoin's rebound from $60K lows may be a dead cat bounce, as the daily charts scream caution and prediction markets price in more pain.

item.title: Clarity Act Passage Would 'Comfort' Markets Amid Bitcoin Volatility: Treasury Secretary Bessent
item.description: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent suggested that the crypto market would be calmed by the passage of the Clarity Act.

item.title: Trump Media Files to Launch Truth Social-Branded Bitcoin, Ethereum, Cronos ETFs
item.description: Truth Social Funds applied for ETFs that would give investors exposure to crypto—one focused on Bitcoin and Ethereum, the other on Cronos.

item.title: Publicly Traded Blockchain Lender Figure Confirms Customer Data Breach
item.description: Blockchain lender Figure said hackers accessed customer data after an employee was targeted in a social engineering attack.

item.title: Bitcoin Is Down Bad, But Hasn't Yet Hit Its 'Ultimate Bear Market Bottom': Analysts
item.description: Despite its 45% fall since its October peak, Bitcoin has not yet found its bear market bottom, according to a new report from CryptoQuant.

item.title: Can Meme Coins Power a Senate Bid? Virginia’s Mark Moran Says Yes
item.description: Mark Moran is using a meme coin on Solana to elevate his U.S. Senate bid, rallying degens against a pro-crypto Democrat in Virginia.
